question: Find the vector equation of the line passing through the point $(1,2,3)$ and parallel to the vector $2\hat{i}-3\hat{j}+\hat{k}$.
explanation:
Position vector of the point is $\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k$.

Direction vector $\vec b=2\hat i-3\hat j+\hat k$.

Vector equation of the line is $\vec r=\vec a+\lambda\vec b$.

Thus $\vec r=(\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k)+\lambda(2\hat i-3\hat j+\hat k)$.

options.A: $\vec r=(\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k)+\lambda(\hat i-3\hat j+2\hat k)$
options.B: $\vec r=(\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k)+\lambda(2\hat i-3\hat j+\hat k)$
options.C: $\vec r=(2\hat i-3\hat j+\hat k)+\lambda(\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k)$
options.D: $\vec r=(\hat i-2\hat j+3\hat k)+\lambda(2\hat i+3\hat j+\hat k)$
